mathematics.assertion_tested: The displayed curvature-sourced QUMOND action derives exact exponential MOND and avoids direct matter variation in its weak static scalar sector, but its full spatial metric variation has nonzero trace-free stress and its required foliation has either preferred-frame anisotropy or an indefinite FLRW auxiliary velocity block.

mathematics.inputs: S_B=(16 pi G)^-1 integral sqrt(-g)[R-2 Lambda-2 lambda(Delta_h chi-R_nn)+2 a0^2 Q(Y)]+S_m, Q(y^2)=1-(1+y)e^-y.
mathematics.bounds: The constant-gradient witness falsifies this explicit Candidate B. It is not a theorem for all nonlinear tensorial nonlocal actions.
non_claims: No complete covariant PPN extraction is claimed after the action already fails no slip and the foliation gate.
The nondegenerate indefinite FLRW block is an obstruction to an auxiliary interpretation, not a substitute for a full inhomogeneous Dirac analysis.
The cosmological a0-Lambda relation is not derived; it remains an external input.
